### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, every trace contained A25, A26, A27, A28, A31, A36, A37 and A42. In the later window, A25, A26, A28 and A31 still appear in essentially all traces, while A27 appears in about 54 in 100 traces and A36, A37 and A42 in about 47–48 in 100. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004]
- In the earlier window the flow was one fixed sequence: A25's outgoing transitions split roughly in thirds to A42 (35%), A36 (34%) and A37 (31%); the group preceded A28 in about 99–100 in 100 traces; A26 led to A27 in about 97 in 100 of its outgoing transitions; and A27 preceded A31 in essentially all co-occurrences. Distances matched: A25 reached A28 typically four steps later (about 94 in 100 pairs) and A26 reached A31 two steps later (about 97 in 100). [DIR001, REL014, REL015, REL016, DIR002, REL010, LAG001, LAG005]
- In the later window, A25 leads to A28 in about 99 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, one step away in about 99 in 100 cases; A26 now leads to A27 in about 53% of its outgoing transitions and to A36/A37/A42 in about 46% combined. [DIR001, LAG001, DIR002]
- The A36/A37/A42 group now runs after A26 (A26 precedes each member in about 46–47 in 100 traces, reversed from before) and before A31: its members lead to A31 in about 28–36% of their outgoing transitions, while transitions to A28 dropped to about 1%. The A26-to-A31 distance is now two steps in about 51 in 100 cases (A27 path) and four steps in about 46 in 100 (group path). [REL006, REL007, REL008, REL017, REL018, REL019, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG005]
- A27 and the group became mutually exclusive: co-occurrence of A27 with each of A36, A37, A42 fell from every trace to about 1 in 100; about 53 in 100 later traces contain A27 without the group, about 47 contain the group without A27. The group itself stays cohesive — A36, A37 and A42 still appear together whenever they appear (47 in 100 traces, neither in about 52) with no fixed internal order, as before. [REL011, REL012, REL013, REL020, REL021, REL022]
- Mean positions shifted accordingly: the group moved from about 0.40 to about 0.58 of the trace, A28 from 0.45 to 0.39, A26 from 0.60 to 0.54, and A27 from 0.62 to 0.58. [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS006, POS007, POS008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis of a structural reordering with a new exclusive choice around the A36/A37/A42 group: in the earlier window every trace executed the group between A25 and A28 and then A27 between A26 and A31; in the later window A25 leads directly to A28, and after A26 each trace takes either A27 (about 53 in 100) or the whole A36/A37/A42 group (about 47 in 100) before A31 — the group is skipped in about half the traces and has become mutually exclusive with A27, which previously always ran. This is shown directly by relational evidence (the order between the group and A28, and between the group and A26, is reversed; A27 co-occurs with each group member in about 1 in 100 traces instead of all), by successor changes at A25 and at the group members, and by consistent participation drops from 100% to about 47–54%, each backed by 94–107 traces; 50 items qualified against about 0.72 expected if nothing had changed, so sampling alone cannot account for the pattern. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC003, OCC004, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL011, REL012, REL013, REL014, REL015, REL016, DIR001, DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, LAG001, LAG005]

Limitations: the evidence cannot show whether the exclusive choice is governed by a single decision point or arises from two independent skip behaviours, nor can it rule out that the later window pools two coexisting trace variants rather than one process with new routing; several distance profiles for pairs involving the group rest on a single observation in one window and are weak. [LAG002, LAG003, LAG004, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008, LAG009, LAG010, LAG011]

Other differences: A25's mean position moved slightly later (about 0.34 to 0.36) and A31's slightly earlier (about 0.65 to 0.63), and A27's position became more spread out; these are consistent with the same restructuring rather than a separate change. [POS001, POS005, POS003]

Let me analyse this evidence carefully.

We have 200 traces before, 200 traces after. Screening: 145 units tested, 50 items qualified, 0.72 expected without change. That's a huge excess — 50 items vs 0.72 expected. So the count is many times larger than chance expectation. So we go beyond "insufficient evidence" and judge by directness, consistency, and ability to rule out competing explanations.

All evidence items are control-flow (OCC, DIR, POS, REL, LAG). No time or resource items, so don't discuss time or resources.

Let me piece together the behaviour.

OCC items:
- OCC001: A27. Before: participation 1.0, mean 1.0. After: participation 0.535, mean 0.545. So A27 occurred in every trace before, in about 54 in 100 traces after.
- OCC002: A36. Before: participation 1.0, mean 1.01. After: participation 0.47, mean 0.475.
- OCC003: A37. Before: participation 1.0. After: 0.475.
- OCC004: A42. Before: participation 1.0. After: 0.475.

So four activities (A27, A36, A37, A42) that were in every trace before now appear in only about half of traces.

DIR items:
- DIR001: source A25. Before: outgoing mostly A42 (0.345), A36 (0.335), A37 (0.31), tiny A10, A09. After: almost all to A28 (0.985), tiny A36, A12, A24. So A25 now leads almost exclusively to A28, whereas before it led to A36/A37/A42.
- DIR002: source A26. Before: almost all to A27 (0.975). After: A27 0.525, A37 0.16, A42 0.165, A36 0.14. So A26 now leads to A27 in about half of observed transitions, and to A36/A37/A42 in the rest.
- DIR003: source A36. Before: to A37 0.366, A28 0.332, A42 0.257, small others. After: to A31 0.358, A42 0.326, A37 0.305, A12 0.011. So A36 no longer leads to A28; instead leads to A31.
- DIR004: source A37. Before: A28 0.32, A42 0.38, A36 0.29. After: A36 0.375, A31 0.281, A42 0.3125, A28 0.010. Again A28 replaced by A31.
- DIR005: source A42. Before: A36 0.361, A28 0.317, A37 0.297. After: A37 0.351, A31 0.340, A36 0.298. Again A28 replaced by A31.

So a consistent pattern: before, A36/A37/A42 each led to A28 (about a third each); after, they lead to A31 instead of A28. And A25 now leads almost exclusively to A28.

POS items:
- POS001: A25 position mean 0.338 → 0.358 (slightly later).
- POS002: A26 mean 0.596 → 0.542 (earlier).
- POS003: A27 mean 0.624 → 0.584, support 1.0 → 0.535.
- POS004: A28 mean 0.453 → 0.391 (earlier).
- POS005: A31 mean 0.653 → 0.630 (slightly earlier).
- POS006: A36 mean 0.396 → 0.575 (much later), support 1.0 → 0.47.
- POS007: A37 mean 0.396 → 0.579 (much later), support 0.475.
- POS008: A42 mean 0.396 → 0.582 (much later), support 0.475.

So A36, A37, A42 moved from around position 0.40 to around position 0.58 of the trace — later. A28 moved earlier (0.453 → 0.391). A26 earlier. A27 earlier (0.624 → 0.584).

REL items — many. Let me group:

REL001-005: pairs (A25,A27), (A25,A36), (A25,A37), (A25,A42), (A26,A27). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, fixed order A before B. After: cooccurrence ~0.47-0.535, A_only ~0.465-0.53. So A25 (and A26) still occur in every trace, but the partner (A27/A36/A37/A42) is absent in about half the traces. When both occur, order A before B is preserved.

REL006-008: (A26,A36), (A26,A37), (A26,A42). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A ~0.98-0.99 (i.e., A36 before A26 etc.). After: cooccurrence ~0.47, A_only 0.53, and now A_before_B ~0.46-0.47, B_before_A ~0.005. So the order between A26 and A36/A37/A42 flipped: before A36/A37/A42 came before A26; after, A26 comes before them (when both present).

REL009: (A27,A28). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 1.0 (A28 before A27). After: cooccurrence 0.535, B_only 0.465 (A28 occurs without A27), B_before_A 0.52. So A28 now often occurs without A27; when both occur, A28 still before A27.

REL010: (A27,A31). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, A_before_B 0.995 (A27 before A31). After: cooccurrence 0.535, B_only 0.465 (A31 without A27), A_before_B 0.525. So A31 now often occurs without A27.

REL011: (A27,A36). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 0.99 (A36 before A27). After: cooccurrence 0.005, A_only 0.53, B_only 0.465. So A27 and A36 almost never occur in the same trace anymore — they became alternatives!

REL012: (A27,A37). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 1.0. After: cooccurrence 0.01, A_only 0.525, B_only 0.465. Same: alternatives.

REL013: (A27,A42). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 0.99. After: cooccurrence 0.01, A_only 0.525, B_only 0.465. Same.

REL014-016: (A28,A36), (A28,A37), (A28,A42). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A ~0.99-1.0 (A36 before A28 etc.). After: cooccurrence ~0.47-0.475, A_only 0.525-0.53, A_before_B ~0.46-0.47. So order flipped: before A36/A37/A42 before A28; after A28 before them (when both present).

REL017-019: (A31,A36), (A31,A37), (A31,A42). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A ~0.985-0.995 (A36 before A31 etc.). After: cooccurrence ~0.47-0.475, A_only 0.525-0.53, B_before_A ~0.465-0.47. So order preserved (A36 before A31) when both present; A31 now occurs without them in about half the traces.

REL020: (A36,A37). Before: cooccurrence 1.0, mixed order (A_before_B 0.52, B_before_A 0.47). After: cooccurrence 0.47, neither 0.525, mixed order among co-occurring (0.21/0.25). So A36 and A37 now co-occur in only about half the traces; in the other half neither... wait, "neither" 0.525 means neither A36 nor A37 in the trace? But participation of A36 is 0.47 and A37 0.475. Hmm, if A36 appears in 47% and A37 in 47.5%, and they're alternatives (never co-occur), then A_only (A36 only) would be ~0.47, B_only ~0.475, neither ~0.055. But here neither is 0.525 and cooccurrence 0.47, A_only 0, B_only 0.005. That means in 47% of traces both occur, and in 52.5% neither occurs. So A36 and A37 always occur together when they occur at all. Interesting — so A36 and A37 co-occur in the traces where they appear (47% of traces), and in the other 53% neither appears. That's consistent with participation ~0.47 each and perfect co-occurrence.

Wait, but REL011/012/013 show A27 vs A36/A37/A42 are alternatives (A_only 0.53, B_only 0.465). And REL020/021/022 show A36, A37, A42 co-occur together in 47% of traces and neither in 52.5%. So the picture: after the change, in about 47-53% of traces we have {A36, A37, A42} together (a block), and in the rest A27 instead (A_only in REL011-013 is A27 only ~0.525-0.53). And A28 and A31: REL009 shows A28 without A27 in 46.5% (B_only), REL010 shows A31 without A27 in 46.5%.

Hmm wait, let me reconsider. Let me reconstruct the two process variants.

Before window:
- All traces contain A25, A26, A27, A28, A31, A36, A37, A42 (participation 1.0 for all these per OCC and POS support 1.0).
- Order: A25 first (position ~0.34), then A36/A37/A42 (~0.40), then A28 (~0.45), then A26 (~0.60), then A27 (~0.62), then A31 (~0.65).
- DIR: A25 → A36/A37/A42 (roughly equal thirds). A36 → A37/A28/A42. A37 → A28/A42/A36. A42 → A36/A28/A37. So A36, A37, A42 form an unordered block (mixed orders per REL020-022: A36/A37 mixed 0.52/0.47, etc.), and the block leads to A28. A26 → A27 (0.975). A27 → A31 (REL010 A_before_B 0.995).
- REL: A36/A37/A42 before A28 (REL014-016 B_before_A ~0.99). A28 before A27 (REL009 B_before_A 1.0). A26 before A27 (REL005 A_before_B 0.99). A36/A37/A42 before A26 (REL006-008 B_before_A ~0.98). A36/A37/A42 before A31 (REL017-019 B_before_A ~0.99). A27 before A31 (REL010).
- LAG: A25→A28 gap 4 steps mostly (LAG001 before: lag 4 in 94%). A26→A31 lag 2 (LAG005 before: lag 2 in 96.5%).

So before: A25 → {A36, A37, A42 in mixed order} → A28 → A26 → A27 → A31. A single flow.

After window:
- A25, A26, A28, A31 still in every trace (POS support 1.0). A27 in 53.5%, A36 in 47%, A37 in 47.5%, A42 in 47.5%.
- A27 vs {A36,A37,A42}: alternatives (REL011-013: co-occurrence ~0.01, A_only ~0.53, B_only ~0.465). So roughly half the traces take A27, half take the {A36,A37,A42} block.
- A36, A37, A42 co-occur when they occur (REL020-022: cooccurrence 0.47, neither 0.52).
- DIR001: A25 → A28 (0.985) now, instead of → A36/A37/A42. So A25 now leads directly to A28, bypassing the {A36,A37,A42} block!
- DIR002: A26 → A27 (0.525) and → A36/A37/A42 (~0.465 combined). So A26 now leads either to A27 or to the block.
- DIR003-005: A36/A37/A42 → A31 (instead of A28). A28 no longer a successor of the block.
- REL009: A28 before A27 still (when co-occurring), but A28 occurs without A27 in 46.5% (B_only). Hmm, B is A28. B_only 0.465 means A28 without A27 in 46.5% of traces. And cooccurrence 0.535. So A27 and A28 co-occur in 53.5% (the A27 traces), and A28 without A27 in 46.5% (the block traces). Makes sense: A28 is in every trace.
- REL010: A27 before A31 when co-occurring (0.525), A31 without A27 in 46.5%.
- REL014-016: A28 before A36/A37/A42 now (A_before_B ~0.46-0.47), cooccurrence ~0.47, A_only (A28 only) ~0.525. So in block traces, A28 comes before the block now.
- REL017-019: A36/A37/A42 before A31 (preserved), A31 without them ~0.525.
- REL006-008: A26 before A36/A37/A42 now (flipped from before).
- POS: A28 earlier (0.453 → 0.391), A26 earlier (0.596 → 0.542), block later (0.40 → 0.58), A27 earlier (0.624 → 0.584), A31 slightly earlier (0.653 → 0.630).
- LAG001: A25→A28 gap was 4, now 1 (0.985 at lag 1). So A25 directly followed by A28.
- LAG005: A26→A31 gap was 2, now split between 2 (0.51) and 4 (0.46). In A27 traces, A26→A27→A31: gap 2. In block traces, A26→...→block→A31: gap 4? Wait, A26 before block (REL006-008 A_before_B). Hmm, so in block traces: A25 → A28 → A26 → block → A31? Let me check positions: A25 ~0.358, A28 ~0.391, A26 ~0.542, block ~0.58, A31 ~0.630, A27 ~0.584.

Hmm, A27 at 0.584 and block at 0.58 — similar positions. A26 at 0.542 before both. A31 at 0.630 after both.

So after: two variants:
- Variant 1 (~53%): A25 → A28 → A26 → A27 → A31.
- Variant 2 (~47%): A25 → A28 → A26 → {A36, A37, A42} → A31.

Before: A25 → {A36,A37,A42} → A28 → A26 → A27 → A31 (all traces).

So the change: the {A36,A37,A42} block, previously mandatory and positioned between A25 and A28, became optional (skipped in ~53% of traces), and when skipped, A27... wait no. A27 was always there before, after A26. Now A27 appears in the traces where the block is absent. Hmm, actually let me re-check: is A27 an alternative to the block, or is the block an alternative to A27?

REL011-013: A27 vs A36/A37/A42: cooccurrence ~0.01, A_only (A27) 0.525-0.53, B_only 0.465. So yes, mutually exclusive: traces have either A27 or the block.

Before, both were always present. After, exactly one of them per trace (roughly). So the block became optional/skippable, and in traces where it's skipped, only A27 runs after A26. Alternatively, A27 became optional and in traces without A27 the block runs. Either way: a new exclusive-or routing between A27 and the {A36,A37,A42} block, whereas before both always executed.

Also the block moved: before it was between A25 and A28 (positions ~0.40 vs A28 0.45); after it's between A26 and A31 (positions ~0.58, A28 0.39, A26 0.54). And A25 now leads directly to A28 (DIR001, LAG001). And the block now leads to A31 instead of A28 (DIR003-005). And A26 now leads to the block (REL006-008 flipped order; DIR002 shows A26 → A36/A37/A42 ~0.465).

So the structural change: the {A36,A37,A42} block was relocated from before A28 to after A26 (before A31), and made optional — in about half the traces it's skipped entirely, leaving A25 → A28 → A26 → A27 → A31.

Wait, but is A27 still after A26 in the skipped traces? REL005: A26 before A27 (A_before_B 0.525 after, cooccurrence 0.535, A_only 0.465). Yes, when A27 present, A26 before it. And A27 before A31 (REL010). So variant 1: A25 → A28 → A26 → A27 → A31. Positions: A25 0.358, A28 0.391, A26 0.542, A27 0.584, A31 0.630. Consistent.

Hmm, but wait — in variant 1, what's between A28 (0.391) and A26 (0.542)? Before, A28 was at 0.453 and A26 at 0.596. The gap A25→A28 was 4 steps before, 1 step after (LAG001). So after, A25 is directly followed by A28. Before, A25 → block (3 activities) → A28, gap 4. So the block was between A25 and A28. After, A25 → A28 directly.

And A26→A31: before gap 2 (A26 → A27 → A31). After: 0.51 at gap 2, 0.46 at gap 4. In variant 1 (A27 traces): A26 → A27 → A31, gap 2. In variant 2 (block traces): A26 → block (3 activities) → A31, gap 4. Consistent with LAG005.

LAG006-008 (A26→A36/A37/A42): before support 1 (only 1 observation — the pair within 5 steps barely occurred before, since block was before A26 at distance >5?), after ~93-94 observations with lags 1-3. Before, A26→A36 lag... the block was before A26, so A26→A36 ordered pair within five steps rarely occurred (support 1). After, A26 before block, lags 1-3 mixed. Hmm, lag 1-3 mixed — interesting, not fixed. Actually DIR002 shows A26 → A27 0.525, A37 0.16, A42 0.165, A36 0.14. So after A26, either A27 or one of the block directly. The block internally is mixed order, so A26 → (whichever block activity is first). Lags 1-3? Hmm, if A26 directly precedes the first block activity, lag should be 1. But LAG006-008 show mixed lags 1-3. Wait, LAG is ordered pair within five steps — the lag distribution of occurrences of the pair. Hmm, maybe multiple occurrences. Actually, wait: in variant 2, A26 → block → A31. The block has 3 activities. A26→A36 lag depends on A36's position within the block (1st, 2nd, or 3rd). Since block order is mixed, A36 can be at lag 1, 2, or 3. That explains the mixed lags 1/2/3 roughly uniform (0.30/0.33/0.35). 

LAG002-004 (A25→A36/A37/A42): before support 200 with lags 1-3 (block right after A25, mixed order), after support 1. Because after, A25 → A28 directly, and the block is far after A26 — more than 5 steps? A25 → A28 → A26 → block: that's lag 3+... hmm, A25 at position ~0.358 of trace length. Actually positions are fractional. Trace length: before, all 8 activities (A25, 3 block, A28, A26, A27, A31) = 8 events. After: variant 1 has 5 events (A25, A28, A26, A27, A31), variant 2 has 7 events (A25, A28, A26, 3 block, A31). Position of A25 in variant 1: 1/5 = 0.2? But POS001 says A25 mean 0.358 after. Hmm, maybe there are other activities not in our evidence. Whatever — the exact trace composition includes other activities we don't see. Doesn't matter for the analysis.

LAG009-011 (A36/A37/A42 → A28): before support 200, lags 1-3 (block → A28 directly, mixed). After support 1: the block no longer precedes A28 within 5 steps (A28 now before the block, and far away). Consistent.

Before: every trace: A25 → {A36, A37, A42 in mixed order} → A28 → A26 → A27 → A31.

After: A25 → A28 → A26 → then either A27 (~53%) or the {A36,A37,A42} block (~47%) → A31.

Equivalently: the block became optional and was repositioned later in the flow; when present it bypasses... hmm, actually when the block is present, does A27 still occur? No — REL011-013 cooccurrence ~0.01. So exactly one of {A27, block} per trace.

Hmm wait, but before, both A27 AND the block were in every trace. After, only one of them. So the total work per trace decreased: variant 1 has A27 only, variant 2 has block only. Actually both variants have fewer activities than before.

Alternative framing: A27 became the alternative to the block. Before: block (mandatory, early) + A27 (mandatory, late). After: XOR between A27 and the block, both positioned late (after A26, before A31).

Now, what hypothesis does this support? The evidence shows:
1. Participation change: A36, A37, A42 (and A27) dropped from 100% to ~47-53%.
